_source: IPCC 2019 Refinement to the 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National GHG Inventories, Volume 4: Agriculture, Forestry and Other Land Use, Chapter 2, Tables 2.3 & 2.5
_equation: SOC = SOC_REF x F_LU x F_MG x F_I  (Eq. 2.25)
_note: SOC_REF values in t C ha-1. Annual DELTA_SOC = (SOC_new - SOC_baseline) / 20-yr equilibration period. Convert C to CO2: multiply by 44/12.

soc_ref._comment: Reference SOC stocks (t C ha-1, 0-30 cm) by climate zone and soil type. Table 2.3, IPCC 2019 Vol.4.

f_lu._comment: Land-use factor F_LU. Accounts for SOC difference between land-use type and the reference (undisturbed native vegetation). Table 5.5 / 6.2.

cropland_annual.note: Annual crop, full tillage — reference is native vegetation

cropland_perennial.note: Perennial crop (tea, rubber, coconut) — closer to native vegetation

agroforestry.note: Trees + crops — treated equivalent to reference forest

paddy.note: Flooded paddy rice — elevated SOC due to anaerobic decomposition

f_mg._comment: Management factor F_MG. Captures the effect of tillage and water management practices on SOC. Table 5.5.

conventional_management.note: Baseline: full-till conventional, no special water management

organic_conversion.note: Switching from conventional to certified organic management

agroforestry_adoption.note: Intercropping shade trees into monoculture perennial crop

forest_regen.note: Active reforestation / natural regeneration on degraded land

improved_water_management.note: Paddy: intermittent flooding vs continuous flood — CH4 reduction

solar_install.note: Not applicable for energy displacement projects

f_i._comment: Carbon input factor F_I. Reflects organic matter inputs to soil. Table 5.5.

none.note: No external carbon inputs, residues removed

low.note: Low: crop residues returned, no amendments — reference level

medium.note: Medium: some compost or green manure applied

high.note: High: regular compost + cover crops + mulch

organic.note: Organic certified: all residues retained + compost + mulch + no synthetic inputs

crop_f_lu._comment: Default F_LU land-use category per crop type.

crop_f_i_new._comment: F_I for the new (post-change) practice per crop type.

baseline_f_mg._comment: F_MG for the pre-change baseline practice (always conventional_management).

baseline_f_i._comment: F_I for the pre-change baseline carbon inputs (always low or none).

district_climate_zone._comment: Maps Sri Lankan districts to IPCC tropical climate sub-zones.

solar_factors._comment: Displacement credits for solar co-operatives — energy methodology, not SOC-based.
solar_factors.methodology: IPCC Tier-1 Energy — Sri Lanka grid emission factor 2023 (0.82 kg CO2/kWh)

paddy_methane._comment: CH4 emissions from flooded paddy rice, IPCC 2006 Vol.4 Chapter 5.
paddy_methane.note: Tier-2, Sri Lanka conditions, continuous flooding baseline

tier_uncertainty._comment: Uncertainty bounds (%) per methodology tier. Used to set tonnes_co2_min/max.

tier_confidence._comment: Confidence score (0-100) shown to farmers per tier.

emission_factors._comment: Activity-level emission factors used to deduct from gross sequestration.
emission_factors._diesel_ref: IPCC 2006 Vol.2 Table 3.2.1 — diesel combustion factor
emission_factors._fertiliser_ref: IPCC 2006 Table 11.1 — EF1=0.01 kg N2O-N / kg N applied, GWP N2O=298
emission_factors._confidence_note: Points subtracted from confidence when fertiliser not reported for non-organic crops

soc_calculation._comment: Physical constants and parameters for IPCC Eq. 2.25 SOC stock-change calculation.
soc_calculation._equilibration_ref: IPCC 2019 Section 2.3.3.1 — default 20-year equilibration period for mineral soils
soc_calculation._c_to_co2_note: 44/12 molar mass ratio of CO2 to C (exact: 3.66667)

satellite_validation._comment: Parameters for Sentinel-2 NDVI cross-check (Lasaponara et al. 2022).
satellite_validation._anomaly_note: Flag if reported > satellite-expected midpoint by more than this fraction (10%)
satellite_validation._range_note: Allow reported value up to 10% above the high end of expected range before blocking tier upgrade

ndvi_scores._comment: Pre-computed NDVI scores from GEE Sentinel-2 median composites, representative Sri Lankan farm polygons, 2024 dry season, bands B8/B4.

ndvi_seq_range_t_co2_ha_yr._comment: Expected net sequestration range (t CO2/ha/yr) per crop type, calibrated against NDVI for Sri Lankan tropical conditions.

ndvi_trend_direction._comment: NDVI trend direction per crop (Lasaponara et al. approach). 'positive' = vegetation density increasing over time, corroborates sequestration claim, enables tier upgrade.
